input.summary: Extend the subscription licence in 13.1 to Affiliates and contractors, remove revocation at Vendor's discretion, and confirm transferability
input.comment: [Playbook] We have extended the subscription licence to our Affiliates and to contractors acting on our behalf, removed Vendor's right to revoke at its sole discretion, and confirmed transferability to an Affiliate or successor, so that Section 13.1 aligns with Sections 13.2, 13.3, and 24. Our position is that a licence must not be revocable at will; if helpful, we can cover Affiliates on written notice as a fallback.

ops.oldText: Vendor grants Customer alone a non-transferable licence, revocable at Vendor's sole discretion, to use the Services without Affiliates or contractors.
ops.newText: Vendor grants Customer and its Affiliates, and contractors acting on Customer's or an Affiliate's behalf, a non-exclusive, worldwide licence to access and use the Services during the applicable subscription term. Customer may transfer that licence as permitted by Section 13.3 and Section 24, and Vendor may revoke or suspend it only as permitted by Section 13.3.
